sections.heading: 1. Build control
lines: ① Dead bug: reach opposite arm and leg slowly.
② Keep your low back down: 8 each side.
③ Side-lying leg lifts: 10 each side.
④ 2–3 times a week, breathing easy.

caption:
Momo loves yoga and bends with ease, but the back aches on days with long holds in deep poses.

Flexibility and strength are different skills. Very bendy bodies may need more strength to control the end of their range, rather than sinking into the joints. Keep the yoga you love and add control with Pilates. Try dead bugs, 8 each side with your low back down, and side-lying leg lifts, 10 each side, two to three times a week.

A joint that feels like it slips, pain lasting after class, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🧘
